decisions.name: go-api-contracts
decisions.reason: This extends tests of the README-established API and CLI contract; exported APIs, supported output, errors and migration behavior are unchanged.

decisions.name: go-core-style
decisions.reason: Writing Go tests calls for idiomatic naming, standard-library dependencies, gofmt, and Go-version-compatible code.

decisions.name: go-interfaces-and-composition
decisions.reason: No production interface, dependency wiring, constructor or lifecycle API changes. Test subprocess fixture ownership is addressed by go-test-isolation.

decisions.name: go-package-boundaries
decisions.reason: The existing external test package and production package responsibilities and imports remain unchanged.

decisions.name: go-test-isolation
decisions.reason: The work mutates process environment, must preserve unset versus present-empty state, owns a temporary compiled binary, and exercises bounded actual child processes.
